english.note: This is the everyday all-purpose noun for a basin used to wash your hands or face.
This is the all-purpose everyday term for a wash basin or sink.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a bathroom sink or washbasin.

examples.english: The sink is in the bathroom; don’t put things in it.
examples.traditional: 洗手盆喺廁所度，唔好擺雜物喺入面。
examples.jyutping: sai2 sau2 pun4 hai2 ci3 so2 dou6 m4 hou2 baai2 zaap6 mat6 hai2 jap6 min6

examples.english: This basin is clogged, so the water cannot drain away.
examples.traditional: 呢個洗手盆塞咗，啲水流唔走。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 sai2 sau2 pun4 sak1 zo2 di1 seoi2 lau4 m4 zau2

examples.english: The washbowl is broken, so we need to get a repairman to fix it.
examples.traditional: 洗手盆壞咗，要搵師傅嚟整。
examples.jyutping: sai2 sau2 pun4 waai6 zo2 jiu3 wan2 si1 fu6 lei4 zing2
